fieldData.job-spec:
What is the job?

With a rapidly growing, global community of developers, brand advocates, and users, it should come as no surprise that the marketing team at RDX Works (the core development team behind the Radix Public Network) is growing quickly and has some ambitious goals for 2022.

Due to this expansion of activity and key results, we’re looking for a highly organized and detailed oriented individual to join our team to help make our marketing campaigns run smoothly. You will be critical in ensuring our various activities are executed consistently to a high standard and support the ongoing analytics reporting and analysis.

This role will be reporting directly to the CMO while working closely with the CSO and other department leads to make sure everyone is on the same page.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Loves a good plan! You will help and assist the wider marketing team in planning, focusing on ensuring everything is covered off and accounted for and ensuring everyone is kept in the loop and on track.
  • Can keep the ball rolling! You can keep multiple people (and departments) in sync with actions and outcomes. You anticipate any bottlenecks and will confidently flag them to necessary project leads and help smooth them out.
  • Takes pride in a good spreadsheet (or similar data dashboard!) With global marketing campaigns and KPIs across a wide range of channels and mediums, you are able to track, collect, and summarise key data to the marketing and leadership team. Where possible, you’ll look at ways to automate and streamline the process end-to-end and empower our team with actionable data.
  • Can build and maintain robust processes! As we are rapidly growing from a start-up to a scale-up, we need to ensure that our marketing team has effective processes in place both internally and cross-departmentally. You will help the CMO and other members of the leadership team design, implement and maintain our marketing processes to deliver consistently best-in-class results.

‍

What do you need?

  • Proven experience in project management within a marketing function.
  • Excellent ability to create and maintain accurate data from a variety of sources and then provide concise updates/reports to key stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Working knowledge of data analytics tools (Google Analytics, HotJar, Social platforms, etc.) and task/project management tools (we use ClickUp).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage information flow cross-department and with all levels of an organization.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to create, implement and ensure processes are followed and achieve consistent, high-quality outcomes.
  • 3+ years of experience within marketing teams, with at least 2+ years of experience within an operations/project management function.
  • Experience within the crypto industry or with multi-sided market businesses is a plus.

‍

Who are we?

At RDX Works (formally Radix DLT), we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

RDX went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply directly here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.
